g.text: Please use CSS style instead of skinparam ParticipantPadding
The Anti-Pattern: Requesting ONLY Missing Scopes
Assumes grants accumulate at the AS.
"mcp:read" was omitted from the request, so it is GONE!
Token grants only ["mcp:export"] -> STILL MISSING mcp:read!
Damage 2: Regression in Previously Working Tool
A tool that worked perfectly 5 seconds ago now fails.
The regression surfaces far from the code that triggered it.
